$comment: Accepted high/critical advisories for audit-scope.mjs (the npm audit (band high) gate).
One entry per advisory, matched on both id and package. Every field is required.
`expires` is the re-review date: the entry stops applying on that day and the gate
fails until someone re-reviews it. Use a short window, not a year.
Shape: { id, package, reason, decision, expires } with expires as YYYY-MM-DD.

ignore.reason: braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS. No patched release exists (3.0.3 is the latest). Reachable only through root build tooling (tailwindcss 3 via chokidar 3 and micromatch, fast-glob, @changesets); not in the shipped closure, which scripts/check-shipped-advisories.mjs checks.
ignore.decision: Decision (Ákos Maurer-Somogyi, 2026-10-16): accept until 2026-11-15, then re-review
